name: Git
description: Understand and commit changes in the workspace's git repository: status, diffs, history and commits.

permissions.reason: Run the git program. Helm runs it inside a sandbox limited to your workspace, without network access.
Let git read the repository in your workspace.
Let git record commits. Only the .git folder is writable; your working files are never modified.

tools.name: git_status
tools.title: Status
tools.description: Show the current branch, upstream tracking and changed/untracked files.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.title: Diff
tools.description: Show the diff of unstaged (default) or staged changes, optionally for one path.

tools.name: git_log
tools.title: History
tools.description: Show recent commits (hash, author, date, subject), optionally for one path.

tools.name: git_show
tools.title: Show commit
tools.description: Show one commit's message and patch.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.title: Commit
tools.description: Stage the given paths (or all changes when all=true) and create a commit with the message.

panels.title: Repository
panels.description: Branch, pending changes and recent commits.

authorName.description: Author name for commits made through Helm.
